source_control.authentication: Gitea Actions credentials sourced from Vault

cache_argument_review.scope: Source review of these three public build arguments only; no new image, signature, cache-hit or performance evidence, and no renewal of other policy reviews or pending controls.
cache_argument_review.scanner_scope: The verifier scans the complete workflow for each associated family, not an individual Dockerfile or build invocation.

FORTEMI_CACHE_DISABLE.classification: public build configuration; never a secret
FORTEMI_CACHE_DISABLE.semantics: 0 permits Cargo mount reuse; exactly 1 selects non-mounted /app/clean-cargo and /app/clean-target while still compiling with Cargo --locked. Other values do not disable reuse; the helper does not validate a boolean. Existing mounts remain attached but are not used for Cargo registry or target output on the disabled path.

FORTEMI_CACHE_FAMILY.classification: public cache identity; never a secret
FORTEMI_CACHE_FAMILY.semantics: The literal build_and_push family label separates compiled Rust target mounts within a namespace and architecture. Cargo registry mounts are shared across Rust families within the same namespace and architecture. MCP receives the label but does not consume it.

FORTEMI_CACHE_NAMESPACE.classification: public cache identity; never a secret
FORTEMI_CACHE_NAMESPACE.semantics: Selects both registry and compiled-target mount identities. The release namespace on the dedicated release BuildKit builder is separate from standalone local defaults and native main/local/PR cache lanes; it does not import PR caches or provide authorization against code with access to that builder.

mcp.rationale: The shared release wrapper passes all three arguments, and the workflow-wide scanner associates them with MCP. Dockerfile.mcp declares none of them and has no Rust compilation or Cargo mounts; this review makes no compiled-cache reuse claim for MCP.

limits: Argument names are explicitly enumerated; review metadata documents source semantics and does not itself enforce argument values or expand the verifier's hardcoded allowlist.
Release --no-cache, immutable base pins, verified APT/TLS and runtime freshness, source/tag checks, smoke checks, signed-publication gates and registry evidence remain required.
Caches are optional build inputs on trusted builders, not proof of source identity, a cache hit or safe execution of untrusted code; Cargo always runs and successful output copying is required.

Compiled targets are architecture/family-separated and keyed by toolchain, packages, manifests/locks, SQLx metadata, migrations, features and PKE selection. Cargo fingerprints source and declared build-script inputs; undeclared external inputs remain a risk.
Retention limits and BuildKit GC are not hard disk quotas. Docker/CI cache reuse and performance still need real acceptance evidence.

license_notices.requirement: Release images must include the license and third-party notice set before this status can become implemented.

digest.evidence: A post-push receipt records the registry manifest digest and proves every mutable alias resolves to that digest.

sbom.reason: SBOM generation runs on every release digest; registry attachment is signed and therefore waits for the release key.
sbom.method: syft 1.52.0 SPDX 2.3 JSON per platform manifest, attached as a cosign spdxjson attestation
sbom.artifact_location: container-supply-chain-evidence-<run-id> CI artifact (365 days) plus OCI referrers on each signed digest in git.integrolabs.net and ghcr.io
sbom.activation_requirement: Operator provisions the OpenBao Transit ecdsa-p256 key, the COSIGN_KEY_REF variable, the Transit sign policy on the CI AppRole, and commits docs/security/cosign.pub; see docs/deployment/image-promotion.md#operator-key-provisioning. Release tags fail until then.

provenance.reason: Provenance is authenticated by the OpenBao-held release key, not by Gitea OIDC (unavailable); buildx provenance and SBOM attestations stay disabled in the release builds so each index holds exactly the linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 images.
provenance.method: SLSA v1 predicate generated from Gitea Actions context and signed with the release cosign key; not an OIDC-authenticated identity
provenance.artifact_location: container-supply-chain-evidence-<run-id> CI artifact (365 days) plus OCI referrers on each signed digest in git.integrolabs.net and ghcr.io
provenance.activation_requirement: Operator provisions the OpenBao Transit ecdsa-p256 key, the COSIGN_KEY_REF variable, the Transit sign policy on the CI AppRole, and commits docs/security/cosign.pub; see docs/deployment/image-promotion.md#operator-key-provisioning. Release tags fail until then.

signature.reason: Signing is wired into release CI; activation waits for the operator-provisioned OpenBao Transit key.
signature.method: cosign key-based signature by digest (recursive for indexes), Sigstore bundle format, no public transparency log
signature.artifact_location: container-supply-chain-evidence-<run-id> CI artifact (365 days) plus OCI referrers on each signed digest in git.integrolabs.net and ghcr.io
signature.activation_requirement: Operator provisions the OpenBao Transit ecdsa-p256 key, the COSIGN_KEY_REF variable, the Transit sign policy on the CI AppRole, and commits docs/security/cosign.pub; see docs/deployment/image-promotion.md#operator-key-provisioning. Release tags fail until then.
